ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity (dark) dominance across >95% of the visible surface area; high-intensity contrast isolated to the distal tips and proximal water-splash interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark-grey/black pigmentation covering the primary fluke body; high-contrast localized clusters of white and tan pixels situated at the extreme lateral tips (coordinates corresponding to the lobe apices).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with a wide vertex angle (~140 degrees) and shallow pixel-depth relative to the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge profile with low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities concentrated on the outer third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge boundary sweeping symmetrically toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-density clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel formations located at the outer distal margins of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of biological growth (barnacles) concentrated at the tips of both fluke lobes.
